name: remove-impossible
description: Remove browser-impossible affordances (bucket A of docs/audit/impossible.md) from the shipped React UI. Backend code in packages/bridge + packages/engine is intentionally kept.

tasks.title: Remove the APBS UI feature: panel, registry launcher icon, and every reference
tasks.instructions: Delete apps/web/src/features/apbs/ entirely (panel + register + tests). Remove `apbs: Zap` from LAUNCHER_ICONS and the now-unused `Zap` import in apps/web/src/shell/OverlayLauncher.tsx. Remove any other apps/web reference to ApbsPanel / features/apbs (e.g. AppShell.tsx). The frozen slot in features/registry.ts STAYS (it renders nothing when not installed). Do NOT touch packages/bridge or packages/engine.

tasks.title: Remove impossible menu leaves from menuData.ts
tasks.instructions: In apps/web/src/layout/menuData.ts remove these leaves (and any submenu/separator left empty or dangling): APBS Electrostatics (dialog:'apbs'); Install Plugin... (dialog:'plugin-install'); Working Directory > Change... (dialog:'cd') and File Browser (dialog:'file-browser') — remove the whole Working Directory submenu if now empty; Recent files ({kind:'recent'}); Edit pymolrc (dialog:'edit-pymolrc'); Log File > Open/Resume/Append (dialog:'log-open','log-resume','log-append') — remove the whole Log File submenu if now empty. KEEP: Open..., Get PDB..., Save Session/As, Export * (reworked later), and Plugin Manager (read-only viewer).
